message: Hi, I'm a student with a machine learning certification background. My overall academic average is 70% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in parallel computing and system developer. I want to become a Information Security Analyst. My family can afford at most about USD 1300 per year. I live in Hyderabad. I'm open to anywhere in India. About the earlier suggestions: please drop PR0186, PR0143.
explanation:
Elmhurst School of Engineering
This program is recommended because it meets your location preference in Hyderabad and keeps tuition well within your $1300 annual budget at only $1000 USD. Furthermore, its minimum admission grade requirement of 62% is safely below your current 70% academic standing. The main trade-off here is that while the placement rate (77%) and starting salary ($11249) are solid, they are lower compared to the other options on this list.

Meridian Institute of Applied Sciences
This program offers the highest median starting salary ($14917) and a strong placement rate of 86%, making it highly attractive for career growth. It is located in Hyderabad and costs $1200 annually, staying within your budget. The primary trade-off to consider is that its minimum required grade percentage (71%) is slightly higher than your current academic standing of 70%.

Sarayu Institute of Technology
This option provides a good balance between cost ($1250 annual tuition) and career outcomes, boasting a placement rate of 81% and a median starting salary of $13142. It also satisfies your location preference in Hyderabad while remaining under budget. The main trade-off is that its minimum admission grade requirement (74%) is the highest on this list and may require you to demonstrate strong academic performance to qualify.
